**Before anything else:** for more than a typo, please open an issue first.
Copyright is held by a single entity so that dual licensing stays possible, and
merging outside code without an agreement would end that permanently. See
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).

**What this changes**

**Checklist**

- [ ] No new dependencies (standard library only)
- [ ] No network calls, no writes to disk
- [ ] Tests added, and any bug fixed is pinned by one
- [ ] `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` passes
- [ ] New coach finding documented in `docs/findings.md` (a test enforces this)
- [ ] Numbers are right or explicitly absent — no estimates presented as measurements
